notes: Salesforce Commerce Cloud (Demandware) site, no ClaudeBot-specific robots.txt block (generic User-agent:* group only) - direct fetch worked throughout, no WAF bypass needed. robots.txt lists many locale sitemaps (da-dk, en-gb, en-us, global, etc.); used da-dk (Denmark, matches assigned country) as the working locale. Root https://www.georgjensen.com/ serves a locale-neutral shell with no nav links rendered server-side; https://www.georgjensen.com/da-dk/ is the real storefront with full server-rendered nav (213 links). Site has 3 top-level shopping sections plus out-of-scope Smykker (Jewelry) and Ure (Watches): Bolig (Home), Til bordet (For the table / tableware), Sølvhåndværk (Silver craftsmanship / fine silverware) - modeled as 3 parent groups below. Per task instructions jewelry/watches are entirely out of scope and were not traversed for decor items (spot-checked: 'ure' bangle-watches and a 'spejlskive' watch-face disc under Torun turned up in a mirror-keyword sitemap sweep but are watch parts, not home mirrors - confirmed no genuine mirror product exists on-site, so no Mirrors category emitted per Rule 0.3 scope). Gaver (Gifts) and Jul (Christmas) sections were not traversed (NEVER EXTRACT Gift/Holiday). Qty verification: every leaf qty below cross-checked via 'Viser N af N' (Showing N of N) header text against a raw count of unique data-itemid product tiles on a single ?start=0&sz=100 fetch (page size 100 exceeds every leaf's total, so one fetch reaches full exhaustion) - all 19 leaves matched exactly (Rule 1 satisfied, no space-thousands-separator concern at this site's small counts). No shopify/magento API involved (SFCC platform). Rule 0.6: Bolig has both a type tree (Lysestager=candle holders) and a room-scoped node (Udendørs Lysestager=outdoor candle holders); overlap is partial (5/8 outdoor items also appear in the main candle-holder listing), not an exact duplicate, so both are emitted as separate leaf rows per 0.6. Vægure (Wall Clocks) qty 16 includes a few weather-instrument variants (thermometer/barometer/hygrometer/holder) from the KOPPEL line that ship inside the same single site category as the wall clocks - kept as one leaf since the site itself does not split them into a separate URL/count. Dropped as mixed non-decor roll-ups after inspecting actual product titles (Rule: 'Mixed roll-ups: drop, don't pad'): bolig/accessories (52 items - dominated by holiday/Advent/Hanukkah candles, keyrings, business-card holders, shoehorns, travel mugs, playing cards, piggy banks - only a handful of decorative boxes qualify and no separate site count exists for that subset); bolig/design-icons (32 items - curated cross-category 'design icon' collection overlapping 18/32 with base categories already counted, rest scattered across excluded sections - functions as a Featured/Collections page); bolig/boeger (1 item - literal coffee-table book, not a decor object); bolig/til-boern (33 items, titled 'Gifts For Children' - piggy banks, rattles, children's cutlery, all excluded categories); til-bordet/borddaekning (293 items) and dining-and-bar/en-underholdende-aften (21 items) and til-bordet/brunch-morgenmad (36 items) - all curated theme/table-setting collections with 24-64% overlap into cutlery + already-counted base categories, functioning as Featured/Collections pages, not distinct product-type nodes; soelvhaandvaerk/soelv-borddaekning (358 items, only 24% overlap with base silverware categories - dominated by excluded silver cutlery) same reasoning; soelvhaandvaerk/skrivebord-kommode (26 items, titled 'Desk & Dresser' - majority are excluded personal/office items: letter openers x5, walking canes x2, money clips x4, magnifying glass, bottle opener, versus ~12 decorative boxes/pill-boxes/potpourri jar with no separable site count - dropped whole node); soelvhaandvaerk/at-play (6 items - silver yo-yo, spinning tops, dice sets, cocktail sticks - toys/games/bar tools, not home decor); soelvhaandvaerk/soelv-accessories (5 items - despite the 'accessories' name these are all sterling-silver chains/'kæde' i.e. jewelry, not home decor). Also excluded on category-type grounds (all confirmed via title inspection): til-bordet/tilbehoer-til-koekkenet (kitchen roll-holders, salt/pepper grinders - kitchen tools), til-bordet/travel-tumblers (personal travel drinkware), til-bordet/bestik + boernebestik + soelvhaandvaerk/soelvbestik + soelvhaandvaerk/til-born (all cutlery), til-bordet/bartilbehoer + til-cocktails + soelvhaandvaerk/soelv-bartilbehoer + til-vin (bar tools), soelvhaandvaerk/pleje-pudsning (silver care/polish products), til-bordet/koekkenmaskiner (kitchen appliances), tilbud/saet-til-hjemmet (Sale), bolig/paaskepynt + jul/* (Holiday), bolig/reservedele + til-bordet/reservedele (spare parts), bolig/inspiration + til-bordet/inspiration + soelvhaandvaerk/inspiration (never-extract), and every per-designer/collection node (Henning Koppel, Bernadotte, Cobra, Bloom, Alfredo, Elephant, Nendo, Chrome Contours, Heart, Lituus, Sky, Copenhagen, Indulgence, New York, Wine Bar, Manhattan, Helix, Anne Boysen, David Thulstrup, Georg Jensen (name), Sigvard Bernadotte, Johan Rohde, Harald Nielsen, Allan Scharff, Søren Georg Jensen, The Artisan Series, Vivianna Torun) which are brand/designer filter re-cuts of the base product-type categories, per NEVER EXTRACT 'Designers, Brands'. First-time DTC extraction, no duplicate-company precedent in this project.
